what_works: Cream + sage + black palette with subtle gold — Scandinavian-warm rather than rose-feminine. Founder copy ('designed to be felt — never rushed') trades aspiration for intentionality, sidestepping the usual women's-brand register.
what_does_not_translate: Product-line catalog structure is e-commerce; the palette move (cream + sage + warm black) and the 'considered, never rushed' messaging register are the portable bits.
type_observations: Clean modern sans-serif throughout — refuses serif clichés. Letter-spacing slightly open on display sets a calm cadence.
